notes.title: Demo update September 2025
notes.content: [p]Hello.[/p][p]There's a new demo update with the game updated to Unreal Engine 5.6. The demo itself doesn't change anything when it comes to content, but I made the update because some people were having some issues that seemed to be related to the UE version I was using (5.3). [/p][p][/p][p]And now, here's a picture of Pame for no reason.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/4f17d14edd0bcc1a472237854602dbc7d42d0ba5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Now I will work on making some changes to the demo level, and also see if I can make some upgrades to the Dolls, since I upgraded my character creation software to the latest version (Reallusion CC5). This new version has some interesting features but I don't know if they will translate well into Unreal Engine. Hopefully they do. I also need to change Cami in the engine (because this demo still uses her old version), but since I need to change Cami and add the rest of the Dolls, I am just going to change all the Dolls to the latest version.[/p]

notes.title: Demo update, Feb 2025
notes.content:
Hello.

There is an updated demo that you can test out. This demo makes various changes and improves different gameplay related things. 

The most obvious change is Moni's new hair. After doing the preview of the new Dolls (Pame and Vero), I realized their hair looked way better than Moni's and Cami's. I decided to go back to those two and improve the hair quality for them too. This is a small change and is purely eye-candy, but I think it's worth it because a lot of work has been put into making the girls attractive, and this improves their overall quality. You can see Moni's new hair below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/63bc956fa135e6cd20ebec899173c61519072135.png[/img]

While Cami is not playable in the demo, she shows up as one of the captured Dolls (context: Dolls become playable as you rescue them in the game). You can see Cami's new look below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/0f5d883ac5167528a59c66e34c0a45bf14c83cd8.png[/img]

On a side-note, it's going to be cool to see Cami next to her twin sister, because, not only they will have different make-up styles, they will have different hair styles.

The HUD has been updated to reflect Moni's change. The HUD also includes pics for Cami and Ceci, but they are not visible since they are not available in the demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/364f861fcf33f358c8ecab3d58c65c81706c683f.jpg[/img]

Keys and locked doors can be associated now, because they now have medallions, rather than using a generic model. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/4e54bdfb0ac182815f837769f8d33585e4df96c9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/f32a43ed2da21b82457dab240555d3c1cfbbca61.jpg[/img]

Moni's moves are also updated. She now moves a little bit forward on every slash of her combo, and has two differend "end-attacks" for the combo, a strong slash that causes knock-back, and an uppercut slash that sends her, and the enemy, upwards. She also can perform the air combo, and link the air combo to a stomp attack. 

The stomp is also faster. She is launched down to do the stomp a lot faster than before.

Overall, these changes can open a couple of nice combat tricks. Other Dolls will have a similar style, at least the ones that use a melee weapon. Cami will be different, as she uses the orb, and her combat style is very different to Moni's or any other Doll using a melee weapon.

[previewyoutube=Wr2c8rLtnRE;full][/previewyoutube]

Enemies have also had small AI updates. Health potions and mana potions now heal more points than before. 

Another small update is the "pain states". The demo includes one pain state: the "chest pain state".

You can see two of the pain states in the video below. 

[previewyoutube=4_qf_S7vxr8;full][/previewyoutube]

The first one is a "chest pain" state that usually happens with a boss strong attack, when a Doll is slammed against a wall. This one doesn't really cripple her too much, as she can still jump, but the dash is limited. The second one is a "lower-belly pain" state that happens when the Doll is targeted on her lower-belly area, and this type of attack disrupts her magical link to the weapon, so she can't perform magic attacks, and she can't jump, but still has a limited dash. There's a third pain state, which doesn't show up here, and acts like the lower-belly pain state, and I'll leave it to you to guess what it is. 

Time for some quick lore. I don't know if this has been explained here before or only on X and Patreon, but, in any case, I am explaining again. The weapons used by the Dolls are called "Nishumas" and are made with some "magical obsidian." Only women can use the magical properties of the weapons, because the weapons detect a woman's life-giving power (fancy way of saying "ability to give birth"), and then link to that power. A Nishuma will never react when grabbed by a man, and will never unleash magical attacks when used by a man (it can still be used as a blunt weapon, though). That's the in-game lore explanation for having only female warriors. The actual reason is that we wanted a game with pretty girls fighting monsters, and we came up with some "explanation" for that.

So we came up with this idea of attacks that target a Doll's lower abdomen and pelvic area as a way to disrupt their "magical link" to their weapons. The first idea was that "magic drain attack" seen in the trailer (the purple demon sucking energy out of Cami's lower abdomen) and then evolved from there to make more physical attacks. This includes the magical spells and also the "cool finishers".

And lastly, there's some minor changes in the demo level, mostly related to areas where you have to fight enemies in tiny platforms. Enemies in those tiny platforms were removed.

notes.title: New demo update
notes.content:
Hello.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/51365f798ff8f544209b17180221ab67e5304cdb.png[/img]

There's a new update for the demo. This update doesn't add/change any new content, but fixes some gameplay issues:
[list]
[*]Health and magic potions recover more points than before.
[*]Enemies can't jump on you so frequently anymore. If you're knocked down, it will take longer for enemies to be able to perform the same attack again.
[*]Enemies can't perform the double-attack so frequently either. If you receive a double attack, it will take longer for them to perform the attack again.
[/list]

Work on Killer Dolls Dark Abyss continues, as the rest of the content is added to the game. We're also working on new screenshots and a new trailer to reflect the new additions to the game.

notes.title: Demo update August 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/23355a72fd7ffb1a4a65af0d048af430a60a4360.jpg[/img]

Hello.

There's a new update of the Killer Dolls Dark Abyss demo. In a post, someone mentioned control remappings were not being assigned on game load, and that they were only assigned after opening and closing the options menu. That issue should now be resolved.

There is also a change in the dash. Now the dash has a very short cool down. Before, you could just spam dash+attack and that made combat less fun and more disorienting. There are also some changes to the demo level so it works with this change (for example, an area where you have to jump on platforms to reach a door). More changes to the level may come to adjust to the new dash better.

Work continues on Killer Dolls Dark Abyss and hopefully there's new stuff to show soon.

notes.title: New demo update available. Demo release 15
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/b7e3973df358ae435cdcb5ee10d3dabaad97d0d2.png[/img]

Hello.

There's a new demo available now. This demo fixes a few issues and also makes some changes to the enemies. Changes should make the enemies more aggressive but allow for more time to react, or at least that was the plan, lol.

The AI for this game is a little tricky because the Dolls are fast, and it's cool that they are fast. Killer Dolls Dark Abyss is a fast game, so it doesn't make sense to have a slow combat with parries, blocking, and it doesn't make to have enemies that "slowly come to you and prepare to attack" either, like other games. So everything has to work according to the speed of the Dolls. The changes only affect the punching enemies and the bow enemies.

This is specially true for, Cami, The Daughter of The Sun (the silver-haired Doll). She's not only fast but can attack from the distance, and her play style forces you to move around since she attacks with the orb.

Other fixes:

Dash direction should be more responsive now. There was an issue that caused the dash to NOT go in the direction you wanted, if you changed direction abruptly and dashed immediately. Now, dash should always go in the direction you want.

The "undead orc" (the orc that revives) should be finally fixed.

Also, the demo should now support cloud saves. This may not be so relevant for the demo, since it's fairly short, but it's there if you need it. The full game will also have cloud saves.

Also, was thinking about adding attack cues to all the punching enemies attacks (the glowing eyes), but I don't know if that's too much. Will continue testing other ways to deliver the attack anticipation for the punching enemies.

As always, if you have any comments or suggestions, drop them in the comments. Also please share this game with your friends. We hope this game does well enough to make more Killer Dolls games in the future!

notes.title: Quick demo update
notes.content:
Hello

There's a quick demo update. This update changes the behavior of some traps, now making it that enemies are also damaged by the spike and blade traps. Long story short, the reason traps didn't affect enemies dates back to the time Killer Dolls was a top-down game, but was never changed. Now, traps will damage enemies.

Also, someone in the forums asked about the unlockable costumes. For reference, these are the costumes we have so far (the two on the right will have their top part redesigned).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/5c72b0475356efba36cf9c6e1f6e94ce7817034e.png[/img]

As always, if you have questions about the game, or comments to improve it, you can post in the forum or comment under this post.

notes.title: Demo update, April release 3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/23e7920f753e179e2bf7cbe1be5b87b8ca142d0a.png[/img]

Hello.

There is a new demo update. This update fixes some more issues and also makes some improvements:
[list]
[*] This one includes the "aim assist" mentioned in a previous update. This should make combat a little easier, because Moni "snaps" to the enemies. This can also help when you try to use the harpoon attack. 
[*] Some small lighting improvements to make everything a little clearer.
[*] Saving spots. The demo has a couple of saving spots now.
[*] Some AI improvements
[*] The issue where enemies still attack you when you're under a "double attack" by the enemies should be fixed.
[*] You should no longer receive damage of any kind if you're on the floor (except for the attack where an enemy jumps to stomp you on the back).
[*] Jump attacks and grabs from enemies are now accompanied by a sound cue to let you know when an enemy that is outside your view is about to attack.
[/list]

We're also working on some cosmetic improvements for the level, so it doesn't look like "all walls and no fun" level. That will be added to a future update soon.

notes.title: Quick update: aim assist (sort of)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/a3f66ef241ed6d153e14e9bfa31b9bc0a9bf797c.png[/img]

Hello all
(This is a transcription of the text in the video, because the text is too small)
We're adding an "aim assist" to close-ranged Dolls to help with attacks and also "cool attacks" and "finishers". This will make it easier to make the "cool attack" hit the target. Long ranged Dolls like Cami will not have that because they don't need it, but may still need a similar solution for the "cool attacks".

Right now only Moni has this, because she's the only Doll that is fully configured for gameplay. Cami needs work (we want to change a bit how she attacks), and Ceci doesn't have anything yet (she can only jump and run).

You can see it in action here:

[previewyoutube=OtoWbf7Cb1g;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Demo update: changes to the tutorial and new move
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/70f330e0d10a5826718b9b34e863625070e0a56b.jpg[/img]

Hello

A new version of the demo is almost finished. We are just testing it and fixing issues we still find. These are two major things we have added to the demo.

The first is a cool finishing move that can be very useful if you are low on health. In the game you will learn how to use this attack, but in the meantime this is how it looks.

[previewyoutube=-XXjSQrNYYA;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

We are also changing the way the tutorial works. In the current demo, you have one tutorial that teaches you almost everything you need to know. We changed that tutorial and now it will teach you the basic things, like attacking, moving and dashing. And then you will have other, shorter tutorials as you get the different unlockable attacks (like spells or finishers).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/8ed1aad5b5b2cc9d9bd47d4af42dd76af24ca944.jpg[/img]

Another thing is we added an NPC to the tutorial that teaches you the things. in the images below you can see him. That's actually Moni's Master. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/7d2a935605b18ada624e1373e7929018be213f82.jpg[/img]

Not sure if every girl will have a different NPC or if we are going to use the same for all. Ideally we would use a different one since (in the lore) each Doll has a different master, but if we can't add all of them, we will stick to this one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/d4a3e4020be134b720e787a89bd6cc08aa444e81.jpg[/img]

We have been doing other, smaller things like improving the lights. For example in the image above you can see the tutorial has a different atmosphere now. Likewise, the demo level also has different lighting now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43808061/59cca19b562b7788a2cbedf31edf4b287b014038.jpg[/img]

We have also been working to improve the AI (as shown in a previous post), and making some small adjustments to make the Doll "snappier" as she's attacking. For example, in the current demo, if Moni is attacking and you want to turn to attack an enemy behind her, she turns slowly. Now in our current demo she turns faster.

More updates soon.
